cards.hint: Focus on the year the protections took effect
cards.quote: Although 12 amendments were originally proposed, the 10 that were ratified became the Bill of Rights in 1791.
cards.stem: In what year did the ratified amendments become the protections described

cards.hint: Recall the total count sent for consideration
cards.quote: On September 25, 1789, the First Congress of the United States therefore proposed to the state legislatures 12 amendments to the Constitution
cards.stem: How many amendments were proposed to the state legislatures to meet objections

cards.hint: Remember the fear of harsh central rule
cards.quote: its opponents repeatedly charged that the Constitution as drafted would open the way to tyranny
cards.stem: What did opponents charge the drafted Constitution would open the way to

cards.hint: Think of gatherings at the state level
cards.quote: Several state conventions in their formal ratification of the Constitution asked for such amendments
cards.stem: Which bodies asked for such amendments during formal approval of the charter
